#### **<u>Highlights</u>** 

###### **China subsidizes purchases of energy-saving appliances** 

The State Council, or China's Cabinet, announced on May 16 that the government will earmark 26.5 billion yuan ($4.2 billion) to subsidize the consumption of household electrical appliances for a one-year period. 

The appliances include air conditioners, flat-panel television sets, refrigerators, washing machines and water heaters that meet energy-saving standards, according to a statement released after an executive meeting of the State Council presided over by Premier Wen Jiabao. 

Meanwhile, the government will allocate another 2.2 billion yuan to promote the consumption of energy-saving light bulbs and LEDs (light-emitting diodes) and 6 billion yuan for purchases of vehicles with engine sizes below 1.6 liters, the statement said. 

Another 1.6 billion yuan will be earmarked to promote the consumption of highly efficient elect

rical machinery, according to the statement, which did not elaborate on how the subsidies will be implemented. 

The statement said the promotion of energy-saving products can help maintain economic momentum and expand domestic demand, as well as boost economic restructuring and energy savings. 

The government will also carry out public campaigns to promote frugality and low-carbon consumption, the statement said. 

Experts said the subsidies may also give a boost to the slowing economy, which grew 8.1 percent in the first quarter of this year, marking the slowest growth in nearly three years. Exports rose only 4.9 percent year on year in April, down from a 8.9-percent increase in March. 

After the global financial and economic crisis, China implemented a series of similar subsidy programs, as Home Appliance Replacement Scheme, China's Home Appliance Subsidy Program for Rural Areas and China's Car Subsidy Program for Rural Areas, that boosted sales of energy-saving cars and home appliances by hundreds of billions of yuan. Adopting short-term subsidy programs is largely intended to expand domestic consumption. The government should carry out reforms concerning income distribution in order to encourage consumption among middle- and low-income earners. That might be more effective. 

It is expected that total sales of Chinese home appliances will be close to 1.3 trillion yuan in 2012, benefitted from government’s subsidy programs and the selling points are energy-saving appliances.

#### **Copper Market Commentary** 

###### **Copper prices go down, hitting the lowest in the year** 

Copper for three month on LME opened at USD8,418/t on May 1, and closed at USD7,425/t on May 31, touching a high of USD8,440/t on May 1 and a low of USD7,425/t on May 31. 

On May 31, LME copper stocks reached 231kt. During the same period, cancelled warrants continued to decline. Cancelled warrants stayed over 93kt at the end of April, accounting for over 37% of the total stocks. But cancelled warrants dropped to less than 26kt on May 24, accounting for 11.6% of the total stocks. Reduction of cancelled warrants was larger than copper stocks on LME, which showed copper stocks on LME would continue its down trend in the future. 

LME copper price continued decline in May. Investors doubted if European leaders had the ability to solve the zone's debt crisis. What’s more, Chinese economic growth has been slowing down and the US economic recovery has been faltering. Risk aversion in copper marker was clearly apparent and copper prices went back to the low level in early 2012. 

Domestic copper price tracked the down trend of copper price on LME. Copper for three month delivery on SHFE opened at 58,880 yuan/t on May 2, and closed at 54,850 yuan/t on May 31, touching a high of 58,940 yuan/t on May 2 and a low of 54, 500yuan/t on May 31. 

Domestic copper stocks reached 147kt on June 1 from 197kt o

n May 4, showing that Chinese copper destocking action has been going on. Chinese copper price is still under pressure, due to Chinese weak copper consumption. 

HSBC Holdings released its own manufacturing PMI on Friday. The reading of 48.4 in May, down slightly from 49.3 in April, signaled a seventh successive month of worsening conditions in the sector. That pointed to a continuous slowdown of the real economy in the second quarter. A PMI figure above 50 means expansion while below 50 indicates contraction. 

From a technical point of view, although copper price got a certain support when close to the lowest level hit in Q4 of 2011, copper price has fallen below the main range formed this year and all kinds of moving averages go down and form pressures on copper price. Currently, short-term technical indicators maintains weak and are blocked. It is expected that Chinese domestic copper price will maintain weak pattern. 

It is expected that LME 3-month copper price will fluctuate in the range of USD7,000/t to USD7,900/t in June, with monthly average price of USD7,350/t. SHFE 3-month copper price will move between 51,000yuan/t and 57,000yuan/t, with monthly average price of around 53,000yuan/t.

**Chinese refined copper production continues to slightly rise in April** 

4                             www.antaike.com 

Copper Monthly   No. 186 



According to data from China Nonferrous metals Industry Association (CNIA), domestic refined copper production was 464kt in Apr, up by 2.0% m-o-m and up by 7.5% y-o-y. During Jan to Apr, cumulative refined copper production was 1.76Mt, up by 6.9% y-o-y. According to data released by National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS), refined copper production was 491kt in Apr, up by 5.1% y-o-y, with cumulative refined copper production of 1.89Mt during Jan to Apr, at a rise of 8.1% y-o-y. According to Antaike’s statistics, refined copper production of domestic 12 refined copper producers reached 340.6kt in Apr, down 0.6% compared with last month; cumulative refined copper production of domestic 12 refined copper producers was 1.32Mt during Jan to Apr, up by 6.6% compared with the same period of last year; of whom, Jiangxi Copper Co, Tongling Nonferrous Metals, Jinchuan Group and Yunnan Copper accounted for over 75%. Above data showed that domestic refined copper production kept a rising trend. Antaike thought that data from the NBS was larger than actual refined copper production. 

According to data from CNIA, domestic copper semis production was 980kt in Apr, up by 11.7% y-o-y or down by 1.3% m-o-m; cumulative copper semis production reached 3.54Mt during Jan to Apr, up by 16.2% y-o-y. Above data showed that copper consumption in Apr was lower than last month but higher than the same period of last year. According to survey results from Antaike, operating rate in Chinese tube companies declined recently, lower than 80%, because most of Chinese air-cond

itioning companies are facing huge stocks and the destocking action may continue to September of 2012. According to data from China Refrigeration and air-conditioning Industry Association, Chinese stocks of household air conditioners reached 18 million sets by the end of Dec. 2011

###### **Chinese refined copper imports keep a m-o-m fall, exports sill at a high level** 

Statistics released by China’s Customs showed that Chinese refined copper import was 273kt in Apr., down by 21.2% m-o-m or up by 70.3% y-o-y. As destocking action continues and Chinese banks control copper financing deals, refined copper import will still decline in the future and it is difficult to go back to its level of early this year. 

Refined copper export kept at a relative high level in Apr, reaching 27kt with a m-o-m rise of 3.3%. But refined copper export had a y-o-y decline of 38.5%, due to the high export volume in April of 2011. During Jan to Apr, refined copper export amounted to 55kt, down by 55.8% y-o-y. It is estimated that refined copper export in May will rise, but lower than the level of last year, under the situation of current domestic refined copper excess supply and low SHFE/LME price ratio. 

In Apr., China imported 370kt copper scraps, at a decline of 13.8% m-o-m and 2% y-o-y. During Jan to Apr, the total import of copper scraps reached 1.43Mt, up by 41% y-o-y, which was 1.38Mt in the same period of last year. Copper scraps supply is still tight in domestic copper market. Some disassembling companies have been in a state of shutdown or half shutdown, although operating rate in these companies slightly rebounded. 

Copper concentrates import was 475kt in Apr., down by 10.5% m-o-m but up by 2.0% y-o-y. During Jan to Apr, copper concentrates import amounted to 2.24Mt, at a rise of 18.5% y-o-y, a sign of rising trend of copper concentrate supply in Chinese copper market. It is estimated that copper concentrats import may not keep at a high level but 500kt is a reasonable in the near future.

###### **Copper consumption** 

According to data from the NBS, among domestic copper-using products output in April of 2012, output of AC motors, household refrigerators, air conditioner and transformer had m-o-m rises. Air conditioners output rose to 15.6mln units in April, at a rise of 10.2% m-o-m, marking a driving force for copper demand in air conditioning industry. Output in other copper-using industries had m-o-m declines, especially in power industry, output of power cable dropped by 36.6% m-o-m, a sign of slowdown trend for copper consumption in power industry. But the situation was not so bad, power cable output had a y-o-y rise of 14.2% during Jan to Apr. Besides, with regards to cumulative output during Jan to Apr, output of autos and transformer during Jan to Apr rose in varying degrees. 

During Jan to Apr, investment in

domestic real estate development was 1.58 trillion yuan, up by 18.7% y-o-y, 4.8 percentage points lower than that in Jan to Mar. Among them, investment in residential houses was 1.08 trillion yuan, up by 13.9% y-o-y, 5.1 percentage points lower than that in Jan to Mar. www.antaike.com 7 Copper Monthly No. 186 Investment in residential houses accounted for 68.3% of the total investment. During Jan to Apr, floor space under construction was 4,271.87 mln sq.m, up by 21.2% y-o-y, 3.8 percentage points lower than that in Jan to Mar. Of them, floor space under construction of residential houses was 3213.73 mln sq.m, at a rise of 18.8% y-o-y. Starting floor space of houses was 544.68 mln sq.m, down by 4.2% y-o-y, while the growth rate was 1.3% in Jan to Mar of 2012, of which starting floor space of residential houses was 406.06 mln sq.m, down by 7.9% y-o-y. Completion floor space of houses was 222.96 mln sq.m, up by 30.2% y-o-y, 9.1 percentage points lower than that in Jan to Mar, of which completion floor space of residential houses was 178.09 mln sq.m, up by 30.1% y-o-y. On the whole, obvious growth slowdown in real estate industry gave a certain pressure on copper consumption. Smoothly construction of indemnificatory apartments will come to be a compensation for copper consumption at a certain degree. Antaike estimates that refined copper consumption in May will reach 640kt, up by about 2% y-o-y. ### **Industrial News** 

**Asele Copper is awarded with the title of Excellent Mine Company** 

Xinjiang Asele Copper Co., Ltd (Asele Copper) recently was awarded with the title of Excellent Mine Company for mineral resources saving and comprehensive utilization by Ministry of Land and Resources of the People’s Republic of China. 

Asele Copper successfully extracted copper concentrate from zinc tailings in 2008. The current extraction rate reached 94.71%, with dilution and loss rates of about 5.28%. Now, Asele Copper can produce over 60t copper content per month from the tailings 

Asele Copper Mine lies in Altay, Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, with proven copper content of 567kt and zinc content of 329.4kt, according to 2011Annual Report of Zijin Mining Group. Asele Copper Mine produced 32.69kt copper concentrates (copper content) and 13.39kt zinc concentrates (zinc content). Zijin Mining Group has 51% shares of Asele Copper. 

**Daye Nonferrous' two copper mine projects expect to be put into operation in 2013** 

According to sources from Zhang Lin, chairman of Daye Nonferrous Metals Co., Limited (Daye Nonferrous, 00661), Daye Nonferrous is expected to expand its copper capacity to 650ktpy in October of 2012 and invest in 2.647 bln yuan in ore mining and construction project. 

Zhang Lin said that Tongshankou Mine and Sareke Mine would be put into operation in 2013 as plan. Daye Nonferrous would give more respects on local culture and custom when local projects were under construction and after completion, Zhang Lin said.
